entities.name: Khwaja Shamsuddin Azeemi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Khawaja Shamsuddin Azeemi was a Pakistani Islamic scholar and a prominent master of Tassawuf (Sufism), holding Ijazah and authorisation from his Murshid, Muhammad Azeem Barkhiya, the founder and Shaykh of Silsila Azeemiyya. As the second head of the Azeemiyya order, he played a pivotal role in its expansion and teachings.
